text: BLOCKED on external data: semantic understanding of combined concepts needs a real natural-language corpus, which this repo does not contain and this session cannot obtain. Measured twice — QD-10 (data/corpus_v2.txt: 41.7% arithmetic, dialogue 190 unique lines of 360,398, type/token 0.14-0.24% vs natural 1-3%) and QD-11 (the only other semantic source, ALL_DATA_TYPES descriptions, fails a shuffled-label control at z=+1.0/+1.6, and its apparent category structure is a form confound — 26% share a category final character vs ~1% chance). Resume by supplying a real corpus, then re-run bench_semantic_composition.py with the shuffled-label control as the baseline.

MitosisEngine calibration defect — RESTORED after being closed by mistake (a 'ing done 1' meant for the corpus-blocker item closed this one instead; it is NOT fixed). split_threshold ships at 0.3 while measured tension peaks at 0.037 and the measurement-derived bar is 0.0397 — 7.6x too high; merge_threshold=0.05 sits above the inter-cell tension too, so the engine can only merge. Threshold-driven mitosis has never fired on any path in this repo (mitosis.demo()'s single MITOSIS line is a forced split_cell() call). QD-6 measured that fixing it forms a population (3.1 cells) but does not improve stimulus retention. Also open: MitosisC.__init__ force-grows by cloning cells[0], which merge_cells then deletes.

Build a clean training corpus. QD-12 disproved the old 'external dependency' blocker: anima/**/*.md is real Korean (1,144,691 tokens / 82,873 types / 6.50% type-token) against corpus_v2.txt's 0.24%. Next concrete step is assembling data/corpus_v3.txt from deduplicated natural-language sources and reporting before/after lexical metrics.
